correctness.rationale: Compute exact projection distances sqrt(3)|1-t|/2 and sqrt(3)|t|/2, yielding branches T(i,t)=(i+1,(1-t)/2) for t<1/2 and (i-1,1-t/2) for t>1/2, with tie at midpoint fixed. Center p=t-1/2; outer |p|>1/2 gives sign flip and r_next=r/2-1/4, so r_m+1/2=2^-m(r0+1/2). Inner 0<|p|<1/2 keeps sign and contracts by -1/2 to s/6: two globally attracting 3-cycles, while exact dyadic shell boundaries hit fixed midpoint. Alternating shell lengths (1/2,1,2,4,...) yield the two limit densities 2/3 and 1/3. Nonperiodic points are nonrecurrent; Poincare recurrence forces invariant probabilities onto 9 periodic points and hence five extremal orbit measures. Independently checked 28 exceptional positions, 15 exact shell endpoint equalities. The phase space is complete lines, not finite sides.
residual_risks: Bounded independent tests corroborate but do not themselves prove the infinite-parameter theorem.
